@'
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import stat
import subprocess
from dotenv import dotenv_values
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdigit():
        continue
    try:
        if (p / 'cwd').resolve() != root:
            continue
        args = (p / 'cmdline').read_bytes().split(bytes([0]))
        assert not any(b'/bin/pytest' in a for a in args), f'Unfinished S5 pytest PID {p.name}'
    except (OSError, RuntimeError):
        pass
print('No S5 pytest process remains (interrupted PIDs 79542/79546 terminated).')
for manifest in ('captures.json', 'rebased-captures.json'):
    for entry in json.loads((root / 'docs/evidence/s5' / manifest).read_text()):
        path = root / 'docs/evidence/s5' / entry['file']
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == entry['sha256'], path.name
print('All historical S5 captures match their recorded SHA-256.')
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', 'HEAD', '--', 'tests/sim', 'docs/evidence/s5/captures.json', 'docs/evidence/s5/rebased-captures.json'])
print('Sim tests, thresholds and historical manifests unchanged.')
blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'hash-object', str(root.parents[1] / 'microduck/scripts/duck-sim')], text=True).strip()
assert blob == 'b95192ba23fa78c91ef3c0db8cc250c4a00fd774'
print('Pollen pre-existing blob unchanged:', blob)
assert stat.S_IMODE((root / '.env').stat().st_mode) == 0o600
secrets = [v.encode() for k, v in dotenv_values('.env').items() if k in ('RELAY_TOKEN', 'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENCLAW_TOKEN') and v and len(v) >= 8]
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']).decode().split('\0')
leaks = [p for p in paths if p and pathlib.Path(p).is_file() and any(s in pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes() for s in secrets)]
assert not leaks, f'Secret matches: {len(leaks)}'
print('.env mode 600; secret matches in tracked/deliverable files: 0 (values never printed).')
for cmd in (
    ['ss', '-H', '-ltn', '( sport = :7841 or sport = :7941 or sport = :7850 or sport = :7851 or sport = :8775 )'],
    ['docker', 'ps', '-aq', '--filter', 'label=com.docker.compose.project=coincoin-s5'],
    ['docker', 'network', 'ls', '-q', '--filter', 'label=com.docker.compose.project=coincoin-s5'],
):
    assert not subprocess.check_output(cmd).strip(), f'Remaining S5 resources: {cmd[0]}'
assert not list((pathlib.Path.home() / '.cache/ds-s5').glob('*.pid'))
print('No S5 listener on 7841/7941/7850/7851/8775; no Compose S5 container/network; no ds-s5 pidfile.')
print('No simulator, relay, Compose or real OpenAI call launched for this corrective task.')
'@ | wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -e bash -lc 'cd "$HOME/projects/microduck/coin-coin-wt/S5" && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" UV_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.cache/uv" && set -o pipefail && uv run python - 2>&1 | tee docs/evidence/s5/announcement-cleanup.txt'
